laws.rule: Under Friuli Venezia Giulia forest-fire law, lighting fires, using fireworks and discarding lit matches or unextinguished cigarettes are prohibited year-round in the law's forest and other covered land, subject to specified authorised exceptions. The law also restricts the use of open-flame appliances, braziers and stoves, except in suitably equipped areas and qualifying mobile campsites. Some authorisations are suspended during declared maximum fire danger.
laws.heading: Legge regionale 17/2019, articles 2 and 19

laws.rule: Friuli Venezia Giulia says that within its parks and nature reserves free camping is prohibited. Individual park or reserve regulations determine the detailed activities allowed.
laws.heading: Norme di comportamento nelle aree naturali protette

laws.rule: Friuli Venezia Giulia says protected-area visitors must not collect fossils or flowers. The authority notes that individual park or reserve regulations govern permitted activities.
laws.heading: Norme di comportamento nelle aree naturali protette

laws.rule: Friuli Venezia Giulia allows non-resident tourists aged 16 or over to collect wild mushrooms under its tourist scheme for at most five days a year. The regional guidance describes a daily contribution to the relevant mountain community or regional decentralised body; an alternative applies to visitors staying at least two consecutive nights who send a prior declaration. Carry identification and the receipt or declaration. Check the specific area and current conditions.
laws.heading: Friuli Venezia Giulia: raccolta funghi

laws.rule: Friuli Venezia Giulia states a general mushroom collection limit of three kilograms per person per day.
